label: sec:stochastic-mechanics-orphan-reconnect-intro
html: The q-machinery has two degenerate limits, and this section takes both. At q \to 1 the Lusztig canonical basis recovers the classical basis; at q \to \infty the reverse limit strips the deformation from the other side. The \Phi_q / A_J identification is what connects the two, and is treated between them.
